subject: SIG: follow-up - access provisioning verification & least-privilege clarifications
messages:
From: Nimbus Health Security <sig@nimhealth.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: julian.alvarez@nimhealth.com
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SIG - follow up: access control clarifications (SSO/SCIM/RBAC/MFA)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the initial SIG submission. A few items in your access controls answers need clarification before we can mark them as validated for our procurement review:

1) SCIM: your answer says SCIM provisioning is supported. Could you confirm whether group membership changes are pushed in real time (near real-time) or batched? We also need an example of a provisioning event (timestamped) showing a deprovisioning for a user.

2) RBAC: please share the role mapping matrix that shows which Redwood roles map to Nimbus roles and the least-privilege rationale for each. We need to see default roles and how escalation requests are handled.

3) MFA: confirm which authentication factors are enforced for admin accounts vs regular users and whether MFA is required for service accounts. If you allow exemptions, describe the compensating controls.

4) SSO/SAML: we require the SAML metadata endpoint and the attribute mappings for NameID and groups. Also confirm whether you support SP-initiated single logout.

Could you upload the supporting artifacts (logs, role matrix, and the updated SIG PDF) to the Drive link in the questionnaire by EOD Monday (Aug 31)? If you need any of our engineers on the call to reproduce a provisioning event, we can schedule a short runbook session.

Regards,
Julian Alvarez
Senior Security Engineer, Nimbus Health
--
Nimbus Health - Security Operations
Attachments: None

- Marissa will attach the role_mapping_matrix.xlsx and add the least-privilege rationale per role.

- Marcus will drop the SAML metadata endpoint and the attribute mapping table.

We'll upload the artifacts to the Drive folder and post back once everything is in place. If Nimbus wants to observe a live deprovisioning replay, we can provision a sandbox account and run through the flow early next week.

Kim / team —

I've pulled the SCIM event window for 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-30 and filtered for deprovision events (DELETE /Users and PATCH role removals). Attached is SCIM_sync_log_2026-06.csv with an example row we can point Nimbus at:

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: julian.alvarez@nimhealth.com, sig@nimhealth.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Role matrix & least-privilege notes (attached)

Julian —

Thanks for the questions. Attached is role_mapping_matrix.xlsx which maps Redwood platform roles to Nimbus roles and includes the least-privilege rationale. Highlights:

- Default user role: "viewer" - read-only access to telemetry and billing endpoints; cannot create or modify models or deployments.
- Developer role: can create model endpoints within assigned projects; sandboxed by project-level RBAC.
- Admin role: full org-level controls; MFA + approval workflow required for role assignment.

Escalation process: role elevation requests go through an approval workflow in our console. Temporary elevations are time-boxed (max 72 hours) and require audit justification; all elevation requests produce an audit record and trigger an email to the team owner.

Service accounts: we do not permit interactive MFA for machine-to-machine accounts. Instead, they use scoped API keys with enforced rotation (90 days) and HMAC-based signing for sensitive operations. For high-risk ops we require an approval ticket and an administrative signer.

I also added a short table showing compensating controls for any MFA exemptions (IP allowlists, time-bound tokens, and elevated logging).

Let us know if you want a short walk-through of the matrix — happy to set up 30 minutes.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Security Controls Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachments: role_mapping_matrix.xlsx

If you can drop those two items to the Drive folder today we should be able to sign off and move to contract finalization.

Thanks — Julian
